A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ECI research work and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–G. Corresponding equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments on stock prices, electricity demand, Delhi temperature and synthetic changepoint data in Section 4, with further experiments and ablations in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–11 and the experimental figures in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: ECI’s partially smoothed update and the ECI-cutoff and ECI-integral variants remain identical in Equations (5)–(7). The scorecaster combination in Appendix G.1 is also already present in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Amazon and Google stock, New South Wales electricity demand, Delhi temperature and synthetic changepoint data. Dataset and task coverage are unchanged throughout the appendices.

E2.justification: The corresponding benchmark comparisons retain ACI, OGD, SF-OGD, decay-OGD and Conformal PID. The smoothing comparisons in Appendix A and scorecaster comparison in Appendix G.1 also retain the same participants.

E3.justification: The 90% target coverage, interval construction, evaluation metrics, base predictors, synthetic-data design and learning-rate searches are unchanged, including the Transformer and appendix experiments.

E4.justification: Both retain the smoothing comparisons in Appendix A.2, scale and window-length sensitivity studies in D, changepoint analyses in E, and scorecaster and learning-rate analyses in G.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental repeated-run counts, random seeds, performance error bars or significance tests. No statistical uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged. Edits such as decay-OGD’s Prophet median width changing from 36.2 to 36.20 in Table 1 and SF-OGD’s Google average width from 88.3 to 88.30 in Table 9 only standardize formatting.

T1.justification: Assumptions 1–2, Theorems 1–2, Propositions 1–2, and the mathematical derivations and proofs in Appendices A–B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about error-sensitive feedback, coverage guarantees, adaptation to distribution shifts and tighter prediction sets.

C2.justification: The explanations of smoothing bias, small-error overcompensation, hyperparameter sensitivity and when scorecasting helps or hurts are unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added or removed.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, the Transformer configuration in Appendix F, learning-rate grids and window choices in G.2, and the code-access link in Section 4.1 are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning relative to ACI, Conformal PID, smoothing methods and other prior approaches remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 replaces several main-text references to 'Appendix' with 'Section' and changes 'proofs are deferred' to 'proofs are referred' in Section 3.3. The organization and substantive prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 standardizes decimal formatting with trailing zeros in Tables 1 and 3–10, with minor text reflow and an updated arXiv version/date stamp. Figures, table structures and their placement remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revision provides cosmetic consistency in table formatting and makes small cross-reference edits. It retains the same scientific content, supporting evidence, explanations and reproducibility information, producing no meaningful net change in overall paper quality.
